anchors.description: Vertical run of 12 brick courses, mortar joint to mortar joint, on the sunlit striped masonry pier between two ground-floor windows
anchors.visible_evidence: The sunlit brick pier (~x 900-950) shows alternating red and cream brick courses with clear horizontal mortar joints at ~5.3 px pitch; 12 course modules are counted between the two chosen joints (64 px span), and individual bricks show the standard ~3:1 length-to-height ratio.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact brick format of this 19th-century Swiss industrial building is unknown; course module assumed 75-85 mm (65-71 mm brick plus 10-12 mm joint).

anchors.description: Seat height of the wooden bench at lower left: point on the seat top surface directly above the front metal leg, to that leg's ground contact
anchors.visible_evidence: A thick wooden seat beam on U-shaped metal legs is visible; the seat top plane (bright upper face of the beam) and the bottom of the front leg resting on the gravel are both clearly visible, spanning ~31 px vertically.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Public/park bench seat heights are standardized around 0.40-0.50 m, but the exact bench model is unknown and the leg-ground contact is partly in shadow.

anchors.description: Height of the visible front face of the black street litter bin beside the bench (top-left corner to bottom-left corner of the face)
anchors.visible_evidence: A tall black rectangular container with a top slot and a round opening stands on the gravel next to the bench; both left-hand corners of its visible face are distinguishable against the lighter stone plinth and gravel.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Municipal litter bins are typically 0.8-1.1 m tall; the exact product is unknown and the slanted top makes the chosen left face edge slightly shorter than the nominal overall height.
